_comment: Multipart rather than variants, because the two things this blockstate has to say are
independent: which way the spout points, and whether there is milk in the tub. As variants that
is a full second copy of a twelve-element model differing by one quad; as multipart the tub is
one part keyed on `facing` and the brew is another keyed on `filled`, and neither model knows
about the other. block/infuser_milk needs no rotation of its own — it is a square surface.
The block also carries `infusing`, which drives the bubbling and steam in
InfuserBlock#randomDisplayTick but deliberately has no model: the tub tracks whether there is
milk in it, not whether something is burning underneath. Multipart matches unlisted properties
as wildcards, so nothing here has to mention it.
A block/infuser_butter texture is already rendered from textures-src/infuser.mctex if a second
brew colour for `infusing` is ever wanted — that is one more part in this list.
